name: Jade Dragon, Adult
body:
ADULT JADE DRAGON
CR 9

XP 6,400
NG Large dragon (earth)
Init +3; Senses dragon senses, greensight 60 ft.; Perception +17
Aura charming presence (180 ft., DC 18)

DEFENSE

AC 25, touch 8, flat—footed 25 (—1 Dex, +17 natural, —1 size)
Hp 114 (11d12+44)
Fort +11, Dex +8, Will +10; DR 5/magic; Immune paralysis, sonic, sleep; SR 20

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., fly 200 ft. (avg.), graceful flight, woodland stride
Melee bite +15 (2d6+6), 2 claws +14 (1d8+4), 2 wings +12 (1d6+2), tail slap +12 (1d8+6)
Space 10 ft., Reach 5 ft. (10 ft. with bite)
Special Attacks breath weapon (40 ft. cone, DC 19, 12d4 sonic)
Spell—Like Abilities (CL 11th; concentration +14)

At will—charm person (DC 14), plant growth, tree shape
1/combat—blink

Spells Known (CL 7th; concentration +10)

3rd (5/day)—cure moderate wounds, summon nature’s ally III
2nd (7/day)—barkskin, forest friend, summon swarm
1st (7/day)—blend with surroundings, detect animal or plants, entangle (DC 14), speak with animals, tripvine (DC 14)
0 (at will)—create water, detect magic, detect poison, grasp, guidance, purify food and drink, resistance

STATISTICS

Str 19, Dex 8, Con 19, Int 16, Wis 17, Cha 16
Base Atk +11; CMB +20; CMD 29 (34 vs. trip)
Feats Improved Initiative, Improved Natural Armor, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Skill Focus (Stealth), Weapon Focus (bite)
Skills Climb +18, Diplomacy +17, Fly +11, Heal +17, Intimidate +17, Knowledge (nature) +17, Perception +17, Stealth +15, Survival +17
Languages Common, Draconic, Elven, Sylvan

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Graceful Flight (Ex)

A young adult or older jade dragon’s aerial maneuverability is one step better than normal.

Greensight (Su)

A young or older jade dragon can see through thick plant matter as though it were transparent, with a range of 60 feet. Greenery, leaves, undergrowth, and vines offer no concealment to the dragon’s sight, though solid wood still blocks its line of sight.

Spell—Like Abilities (Sp)

An adult jade dragon gains charm person, tree shape, plant growth as spell-like abilities, usable at will.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate and warm forests and jungles
Organization solitary
Treasure triple

Jade dragons are the guardians of untamed forests. They often consort with good—aligned druid circles and are benevolent with lost travelers as long as they respect wildlife.
